title: Blue Thunder (film)
intro: Blue Thunder is the fictional armoured surveillance helicopter of the film Blue Thunder (1983). It has a 20 mm cannon that follows the pilot's helmet, a near-silent whisper mode and a turbine boost. The pilot sits in front, and the observer sits behind at the cameras, recorders and long-range microphones.

areas.name: Helmet sight
areas.text: The pilot's helmet aims the chin turret.

panels.name: Helmet sight
panels.text: The pilot's helmet is linked to the gun turret under the nose.
panels.context: Wherever the pilot looks, the cannon points.

controls.name: Helmet sight
controls.text: A sight on the pilot's helmet. The 20 mm turret under the nose follows the pilot's head.
controls.context: The pilot aims the cannon just by looking at the target.

controls.name: Chin turret
controls.text: A 20 mm cannon in a turret under the helicopter's nose.
controls.context: It is aimed by the helmet sight and fired with the trigger on the cyclic.

areas.name: Instrument panel
areas.text: Flight displays in front of the pilot.

panels.name: Instrument panel
panels.text: The flight displays and the controls for whisper mode and turbine boost.
panels.context: These two special modes make the helicopter quiet or extra fast.

controls.name: Flight displays
controls.text: Screens show the flight data to the Blue Thunder pilot.
controls.context: The pilot watches them while flying low over the city.

controls.name: Whisper mode

positions.name: WHISPER
positions.text: Whisper mode: the helicopter flies almost silently.

positions.name: NORMAL
positions.text: Normal mode: the helicopter makes its usual noise.

controls.text: This control switches whisper mode on, which makes the helicopter almost silent.
controls.context: It lets the crew watch and listen without being heard.

controls.name: Turbine boost
controls.text: This control gives the engines a boost for extra speed.
controls.context: It helps in a chase, for example to escape other aircraft.

areas.name: Surveillance station
areas.text: The observer's station behind the pilot.

panels.name: Surveillance station
panels.text: The observer's equipment for watching, listening and recording.
panels.context: Blue Thunder is built to watch people from the air.

controls.name: Cameras
controls.text: Day cameras and infrared cameras, which see heat and work in the dark.
controls.context: The observer films what the helicopter watches.

controls.name: Audio pickups
controls.text: Long-range microphones that can hear people far away.
controls.context: Together with whisper mode they let the crew listen without being noticed.

controls.name: Recorders and data link
controls.text: Recorders and a computer link to databases.
controls.context: The crew records what they see and hear and looks up information while flying.

areas.name: Cyclic and collective
areas.text: The hand controls the pilot flies with.

panels.name: Cyclic
panels.text: The cyclic stick in front of the Blue Thunder pilot.
panels.context: It tilts the helicopter and fires the cannon.

controls.name: Cyclic
controls.text: Pushing the cyclic forward tips the helicopter forward so it flies forward; moving it sideways makes it fly sideways.
controls.context: It tilts the rotor in the direction the pilot wants to fly.

controls.name: Cannon trigger
controls.text: A trigger on the cyclic grip fires the 20 mm cannon.
controls.context: The cannon points wherever the pilot looks through the helmet sight.

panels.name: Collective
panels.text: The collective lever at the Blue Thunder pilot's left hand.
panels.context: It makes the helicopter climb or sink.

controls.name: Collective
controls.text: Pulling the collective up makes the helicopter climb; pushing it down makes it sink.
controls.context: It changes how strongly the rotor blades bite the air.
